label: v107
changes: Fixed: the document scanner could silently fail on detail-heavy photos like ID cards — it now compresses before saving instead of discarding the scan
The camera scanner is now available everywhere you'd expect it — the AI chat has its own camera button, and ID & Passports can now scan straight in
Scanning an ID card now asks for the back too, and saves both sides as one document
Document thumbnails in a member's Documents tab are now bigger and easier to see
